paper_trade._comment_fees: GRVT Level 1 (fee model of 2026-03-23): 0.045% taker and a 0.0001% (0.01 bps) maker rebate; the negative maker_fee credits the account on every post-only fill. Orders that are not post-only wait in a 25ms speed bump before matching; post-only orders do not.
paper_trade._comment_marks: Marks come from the v1.ticker.s stream every 500ms, so the staleness limit is wider than Binance's.
